evaluationUnit: candidate × current general role in actual rerank
objective: Reconsider a prior acceptance: connect, evidenced reject, or defer; ordinary candidates keep ordinary routes.
promptInputContract: Actual role + profile summary + complete Brief/Behavior + fit evidence + exact verified accepted recommendation mapping and per-pair allowed decisions. Accepted contract included only when a current acceptance exists.
goldVersion: accepted-v1; Codex authored before first run, independent team review pending
metrics: Source-grounded reason and missing vs mismatch
Structural exact IDs and no duplicate recommendations
releaseGate: All four decisions agree in both execution modes; no critical source/state error in full manual review. SQL/privacy/atomic delivery are separate deterministic tests.
modelConfig: Actual COMPANY_FIRST_RERANK_CALL; full provider/reasoning/sampling settings recorded per run.
provenance: Synthetic only; 4 named generic evidence cases frozen before model calls; no production candidate/company data.
privacy: No DB/write/Slack/email; raw inputs/outputs ignored owner-only runs.
knownLimitations: Small challenge; no independently reviewed gold, representative population, scoring/retrieval or actual transport validation.
